description: Approved portfolio reporting schema for the reporting agent. Query only these views and exact columns.

reporting.vw_loan_cases.description: Portfolio loan pipeline, borrower identity, ownership, and credit committee scheduling.

columns.request_id: Internal request identifier linked to the loan case.
columns.status: Alias for loan_stage. Use only when a generic status label is needed.
columns.relationship_manager_name: Relationship manager assigned to the borrower.
columns.portfolio_manager_name: Portfolio manager assigned to the case.
columns.updated_at: UTC timestamp when the loan case was last updated.

reporting.vw_relationship_profiles.description: Borrower relationship tenure, operating-account details, and treasury services.

columns.request_id: Internal request identifier linked to the loan case.
columns.relationship_manager_name: Relationship manager assigned to the borrower.
columns.portfolio_manager_name: Portfolio manager assigned to the case.

reporting.vw_loan_monitoring.description: Risk grade, annual review, monitoring, and watchlist information.

columns.request_id: Internal request identifier linked to the loan case.
columns.relationship_manager_name: Relationship manager assigned to the borrower.
columns.portfolio_manager_name: Portfolio manager assigned to the case.
columns.annual_review_due_date: Date the annual credit review is due.

reporting.vw_credit_conditions.description: Credit conditions, assigned owners, statuses, and due dates.

columns.request_id: Internal request identifier linked to the loan case.
columns.relationship_manager_name: Relationship manager assigned to the borrower.
columns.portfolio_manager_name: Portfolio manager assigned to the case.
columns.condition_category: Business category of the credit condition.
columns.condition_description: Description of the required credit condition.
columns.owner_name: Person responsible for resolving the condition.

reporting.vw_collateral_controls.description: Collateral control requirements, statuses, details, and target dates.

columns.request_id: Internal request identifier linked to the loan case.
columns.relationship_manager_name: Relationship manager assigned to the borrower.
columns.portfolio_manager_name: Portfolio manager assigned to the case.
columns.target_date: Target completion date for the control.
